draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Sasthamcotta! The lake here is the largest freshwater lake in Kerala, and its water is famously pure because tiny larvae called cavaborus eat the bacteria. It has been a Ramsar wetland of international importance since November 2002.
draft.hungryLine: The lake supports local fishing, so fresh fish is the thing to ask for around Sasthamcotta.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk to the Sree Dharma Sastha Temple, which has the lake wrapped around three sides, then carry on to the lake shore.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Sit by Sasthamcotta Lake and watch the still water. Half a million people drink from it.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The temple monkeys have their own trust fund, set up in 1996 so they keep getting fed even when natural food runs short.

legends.title: The holy monkeys
legends.body: Monkeys live all over the temple grounds, and they are believed to be holy. People care for them so much that a trust fund feeds them.

legends.title: Sastha and his family
legends.body: The temple's deity is Shri Dharma Sastha, with his consort Prabha and son Sathyaka. Sastha is seen as a meeting of Vaishnava and Saiva beliefs.

tips.title: Keep the lake clean.
tips.body: Sasthamcotta Lake is drinking water for half a million people in Kollam district.

tips.title: See the lake from the temple.
tips.body: The Sastha temple is surrounded on three sides by the lake, so it's the easiest lake view.

story.title: A temple by the water
story.body: The ancient Sastha temple stood on the lake bank, and the lake took its name from it. It is one of five ancient Sastha temples in Kerala, along with Sabarimala.

story.title: Looking after the monkeys
story.body: A trust fund was set up so the temple monkeys would always be fed, even when natural food dwindled.

story.title: A wetland the world noticed
story.body: Sasthamcotta Lake was named a wetland of international importance under the Ramsar Convention.

story.title: Water for half a million
story.body: The lake meets the drinking water needs of about half a million people in Kollam district and still supports fishing. Sasthamkotta is the headquarters of Kunnathur taluk.
